an incredibly saturated and sustaining Extreme Metal High Gain Distortion with Active Gyrator EQ's, with extra Grind Rectifier and Boost Sep 17, 2026 12:00 by Stefan Karlsson Distortion Dr Scientist Metal Distortion Full Article Read Summary Key Points Dr. Scientist’s Dungeon Crawler is an extreme-metal high-gain distortion built around three very-high-gain 2N7000 MOSFET clipping stages, delivering blistering saturation and near-endless sustain. TL074 JFET-input gyrator EQ stages provide post-gain Lows (90Hz), Lower Mids (420Hz), Upper Mids (1kHz), Highs (3kHz), plus Thick (130Hz pre-gain) and Presence. Boost adds volume and gain; Grind is a Silicon NPN rectifier for coarser nastiness. A comparator Gate has an internal sensitivity trimmer. Two LEDs shift from amber to brighter red with input gain. Controls include Gain, Volume, Mix and EQ. It was listed at $249 USD / £229. A killer magnificently saturating Extreme Gain Distoriton - which does the Grinding Metal thing exceptionally well - with almost limitless saturation and sustain. It’s not the sludgiest of distortions or necessarily the most thudding and thunderous in the low end - but it sounds magnificent throughout its range. It leans somewhat more toward the modern side of things - with a really tight, and hard delivery, rather than vintage spongy sag. It does have a great vintage voicing here - in terms of the low-end-delivery, but I have other distortions which are a touch more pounding and thunderous. Overall it’s incredibly well balanced, and with a tonne of potency in reserve. You do get into squishy compression if you overly elevate some of those dials - which is why some don’t go beyond 3 o’c for me, while others are free to roam! The sustain here is a thing of wonder - you get blistering saturation - with almost endless sustain. And you can further ramp up the pedal up in various ways - but mostly via the Boost Footswitch, and the Grind control. For me my default is with Boost off and Grind wound all the way back. I tend to use Grind in a very binary fashion - either all-out - or all-in! The 3 x Very High Gain 2N7000 MOSFET Clipping Stages at the heart of the circuit are what give it that amazing saturation and sustain.
